title: The Civil War Against Benjamin
description: After the horrific crime in Gibeah, the tribes of Israel gather at Mizpah to punish the tribe of Benjamin. The Benjamites refuse to hand over the guilty parties, and a civil war breaks out. Israel loses the first two battles with heavy casualties, but after fasting and praying to the Lord before the ark of the covenant at Bethel, they win a decisive victory using an ambush. The tribe of Benjamin is nearly wiped out; only six hundred men survive at the rock of Rimmon.
